routing.sequence: Actual Dragon type commit/reaction -> one dragon-form commit and +2 ledger/reaction -> one element-universal commit and selected linked power/reaction -> exact saved caller.
routing.profileAuthority: Dragon type/form profiles here are canonical. Race registration/import pointers are inspection/routing references; execute one profile per committed source, not each pointer as a separate event.
routing.otherImported: All eight Imported Mythical Beast event routes are now defined. Griffin and the five delegated three-point packages are fixed profiles in mythical-beast-events-design.json; Dragon retains only its own form/Element route.

numericStats.timing: Commit modifiers atomically with the form result before reaction; preserve immutable base and project through the existing final-stat ledger. +2 is a total budget, never +2 each stat.
numericStats.lateActivation: If an authorized source is acquired after a base stat exists, reproject from that same base and current distinct modifiers; no new stat spin.

element.affinity: Body form does not force any element or change its weights. Sea Serpent can receive Api, Western can receive Air. Selected element and control come only from the canonical child.
element.grantAuthority: Only the selected canonical Element outcome records the element and grants its linked manipulation power. The Dragon caller grants no second copy.
element.roster: Reuse the existing adjustable starter. Do not create a Dragon-only pool or silently add Ice/Lightning/Poison/Light/Dark.

inventory.early: Retain the selected control power after main Power None; ordinary main Power acquisition still occurs.
inventory.mastery: All owned powers use the single character Power Mastery at its normal stage. Dragon grants no mastery boost or automatic maximum, and Power Mastery triggers no Enchant.
inventory.body: Selected wings, legs, fins and mythology motifs are visual reference. This event grants no separate Flight, breath weapon, venom, regeneration, armor, immunity, swimming/flight stat rule, or equipment.

identity.family: Dragon forms remain a source-scoped Mythical Beast component. No Naga local selector, Elemental race event or extra race draw is dispatched.
identity.history: Use existing shared used-family history on actual family draws; form/element are not new race-family draws.
identity.nested: Run the same approved event in Hybrid, Symbiote host, Raksasa base and Skeleton/Zombie origin components, keeping provenance and their saved continuation. Do not erase wrapper identity or advance main stages early.

size.stage: The one global Size stage after Backstory and before stats.
size.profiles: Per-form body metric and source reference remain pending; neither bonus nor a source drawing assigns dimensions. Raksasa retains its existing giant Size binding.

idempotence.rule: Register each source effect once. Replay restores recorded result/odds/effects/context without a new form/Element draw, duplicate bonus or duplicate grant.

context.stack: Keep source component, actual type/form result IDs, visual variant and committed bonus ledger in stacked context. Later append the actual Element/power with its child source.
context.unknown: Before form commitment do not expose chosen bonus/body; before Element commitment do not claim an element or control power; before stats/mastery do not fabricate bases/final totals/ranks.
context.reaction: Every actual type, form and Element spin gets its own result/reaction. Fixed +2 effects add no fake spin or automatically funny result.
